game_concept: A puzzle set in Snowy Hold – Lantern Square, a lantern-lit square: the snow ranger must handle ice wolves while practicing functions. Core idea – Boolean Guards: Write functions returning True or False that guard checkpoints.
theme: Snowy Hold – Lantern Square: a lantern-lit square
core_gameplay_loop: In Lantern Square, repeat each round: Write functions returning True or False that guard checkpoints. Each round costs one action, so plan the step so none are wasted. Then check the guards value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Bonus coins for fast correct moves
player_objective: Reach the sleigh using at most 21 actions, so every code step counts.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 21 before the sleigh is reached, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 6 – Functions | Level 6 (applied tier): Boolean Guards
assets_style: cozy pixel-art snow town: icy blue rooftops, frosted pines, warm lantern glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; soft bells, wind howls and cozy hearth crackle
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Boolean Guards' (Week 6 slot 10), mission type 'Efficiency Trial', and setting 'Lantern Square'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Snowy Hold
region.mood: soft bells, wind howls and cozy hearth crackle

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how guards changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against ice wolves in Lantern Square.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: The sleigh reached with actions_used <= 21.
